title: Rules.
bodyText: The department of human services shall maintain rules describing eligibility criteria for adoption assistance and describing the types, duration, and amounts of adoption assistance benefits that may be received.
bodyHtml: [§346-303]  Rules.  The department of human services shall maintain rules describing eligibility criteria for adoption assistance and describing the types, duration, and amounts of adoption assistance benefits that may be received. [L 1992, c 190, pt of §1]
